title: Jefferson School African American Heritage Center

services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: Join us for a one-hour tour where we explore exhibitions in our contemporary gallery or the history of Charlottesville through our permanent exhibition Pride Overcomes Prejudice. Tours are given by our Center for Local Knowledge and our Learning and Engagement curators on the third Saturday of every month. blurb: Located in the Jefferson School City Center, The Jefferson School African American Heritage Center’s mission is to honor and preserve the rich heritage and legacy of the African-American community of Charlottesville-Albemarle, Virginia and to promote a greater appreciation for, and understanding of, the contributions of African Americans and peoples of the Diaspora locally, nationally.
